profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.summary:
A full stack problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies.
Love data-driven design and challenges in programming complex algorithms.
Very strong in coding with the ability to develop quick solutions when issues arise.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain the front end and back end functionality of websites. 
•	Experience building responsive and modern sites with best practice techniques 
•	Designing prototypes for apps and websites.
•	Develop Joomla websites, specifically in the environment oriented non-profit space 
•	Maintain servers and hosting for clients
•	Manage the development of application concept, design and research.
•	Increase traffic and enhanced page ranking by improving website structure, front end design.
•	Develop UI/UX methodologies that incorporate wireframes and mockups and for small 
and medium-sized businesses.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
•	Make strategy for success angling deals to 3 millions in first year and 10 millions dollars in 2017.
•	Work with obtaining staff to build up quality prerequisites for outer providers
•	Monitor nature of approaching materials for consistence.
•	Assist in preparing new colleagues.

positions.title: Oracle Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed various Oracle Applications using PL/SQL, SQL*Plus, Forms, Reports, Workflow Builder, and Application Object Library.
•	Managed and supported all modules of Oracle e-Business Suite R11i (Finance, Order Management, Supply Chain).
•	As project manager, worked with users through all Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) phases.
•	Created extensions using Oracle recommended frameworks. 
•	Created reports against Applications data model.
•	Wrote technical design documents for conversions, extensions, interfaces, and reports.
•	Troubleshoot issues, including creation/follow-up of Oracle service requests (SRs).
•	Conducted quality reviews of code developed by other development staff.
•	Developed custom Oracle Payable Approval module that reduced department and company cost.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Develop and maintain website: northhollywoodchurch.org
•	Provide trained, qualified AV operators for all worship services, ministry events, and special events of church.
•	Provide technical expertise and solutions relative to live audio, recorded audio, web audio, lighting and stage production for the church facility.
•	Responsible for maintaining AV and facilities AV budgets within approved annual guidelines as well as developing written strategic and expenditure proposals as needed throughout the year.
•	Responsible as team leader and coach for AV ministry volunteer teams.
